# /crav1-verify-build-against-spec

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Verify and fix](../../from-verify.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-verify-build-against-spec/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Map every v0 acceptance line to tests or UI checks and report pass, fail, or missing.

TL;DR of implemented vs not, then acceptance details in `verify.md`.

Before the tests, a local dependency preflight checks Azurite, database containers, and emulators the repo's tests name, and asks start, skip, or stop for one that is not running. A test skipped for a missing dependency blocks verified unless you chose skip; then `verify.md` lists it under Skipped tests. A missing dependency is a `BLOCKER:` line at the top of the summary, also in a headless run, which uses the two-pass questions file.

1.64.0: the TL;DR adds a Branches line (merged into the base, deleted-but-merged, rewritten, shared); demoable needs every work branch merged. Report only.

1.68.0: the `Sub-branches:` and `left behind:` lines, done when the top-level branches reached the base, and `merged, reverted on <base> (<sha>)`, report only.

1.69.0: the `Promotion:` line in the TL;DR and verify.md, with the optional `pipeline runs` check; done stays merged.

## Choice words

Exact words for bots and scripted runs (no `--flags`). A word in the invocation takes that choice without asking. A headless or bot run with no word stops and names the valid words.

| Question | Word | Means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Also check the latest pipeline runs? | `pipeline runs` | check the latest successful Azure DevOps runs behind the Promotion line (read-only) |

## Runs when

Want proof against acceptance. Called by the user and by `crav1-build-task-agent`.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 3 (the most prompts in one run, the closing yes included). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: Spec, tasks, plan, and the running tree.

Reads `spec.md`, `tasks.md`, `plan.md`, and the running tree.

## Writes

In short: `verify.md`.

Writes `verify.md`.

## Does not

Leaves `spec.md` and product code alone.

Limits and exceptions: does not run [`/crav1-fix-bug`](crav1-fix-bug.md) or [`/crav1-review-pr`](crav1-review-pr.md).
